card.name: Start of a sentence about experience or study numbers
card.fires_on: The word Experience (or experience) opening a new sentence after a period in drug label text. Also a blank space before a number of subjects, such as 'In 20 healthy subjects'.

modes.label: Sentence-opening Experience
modes.description: The word Experience starts a sentence that reports clinical experience with a drug or procedure.
